name: order_id
description: Unique Google Store customer order number (PK, e.g. ORD-2026-8701)

name: sku_id
description: Ordered hardware model SKU (FK to products_catalog.sku_id)

name: fulfillment_hub
description: Fulfillment center assigned to dispatch order (FK to hub_inventory.hub_code)

name: destination_country
description: Destination country ISO code (ES, FR, DE, IT, UK)

name: carrier_partner
description: Assigned parcel logistics courier (DHL Express, DPD Europe, UPS)

name: order_status
description: Order fulfillment state (DELIVERED, SHIPPED, ALLOCATED, TRANSIT_DELAYED, PENDING_INSPECTION, ESCALATED_DISPUTE)

name: total_paid_eur
description: Final customer transaction value in Euro (€)
